name: ground-level-contracting
description: Single production app: Next.js in glc-site. Dev: npm run dev (Turbopack, port 3040). Webpack-only: npm run dev:webpack --prefix glc-site. Prefer http://127.0.0.1:3040/ on Windows if localhost fails. Chunk/HMR errors: npm run dev:fresh. Production: npm run build && npm run start.
